name: Home Doctor
description: Daily Cloud Doctor pass: inspect apple-tasks + Hermes + Home Assistant, notify on salient failures, PR or [hermes] follow-up only when the same signature repeats. EventKit has no hourly recurrence — daily at 08:00 is the standing schedule.
title: Home Doctor: inspect Hermes, Home Assistant, and failed dispatches
notes:
Inspect only. Policy is injected by dispatch for [doctor] tasks.

Read apple-tasks doctor, apple-tasks dispatches --status failed, ~/.hermes/gateway_state.json, and ~/.hermes/cron/jobs.json.
Never print secrets or .env values. Do not toggle Home Assistant entities on this pass.
Complete the task when the inspect finishes so the daily series rolls forward.
